confidence_notes: Overall low. Restaurant meal and coffee anchors are rough aggregator figures, some dated 2022-2023, with inconsistent LKR conversions. Beer, cocktail and wine are inferred from one Galle cocktail data point, a 2024 Tangalle resort menu and a beer-relative rule, not from current Galle menus. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate; no booking pages or listings were inspected. LKR figures were converted at an assumed rate of about 320 LKR per USD, not a searched rate. The FX value comes from search-result excerpts of the RBA exchange-rate data for 2026-10-16; the RBA page itself was not opened.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city. Basis is a South Asian coastal tourist town, anchored to Galle aggregator restaurant and coffee figures and cross-checked against Hikkaduwa/Weligama-area reference points and a 2024 Tangalle resort menu. Drink anchors use local beer as the reference: cocktail about 2.9x beer and wine glass about 2.3x beer.
